statement: The GL-free diagnostic bundle core resolves CLI and environment opt-in, rejects malformed probes, normalizes bottom-first source planes to top-first codec inputs, joins identities to capture-local draw records and streams one plane at a time under an aggregate 512 MiB staging budget checked before image allocation. Filesystem publication refuses occupied bundle members, checks stream, flush and close, publishes completion metadata last and uses identity-checked cleanup for owned artifacts. Metadata links the capture manifest, records frame and camera, labels the deferred surface and serializes explicit unsupported submission records. Registered regressions cover parsing, admission before save-root output, orientation, probe consistency, exact budget boundaries, input and transport failures, existing destinations, rollback and disabled no-op. Native execution remains pending. Runtime admission accepts enabled diagnostics only for the world_visual_sweep scenario, --frame-scan, or --render-benchmark with --render-benchmark-screenshot; those paths reserve their bundle destination exclusively and check completed-frame readiness before the manifest is published. Every other scenario and the --render-parity-frame and --upscale-seam-parity redispatches refuse enabled diagnostics before save-root output; production play cannot enable diagnostics.

evidence.planned: Complete GL readback, scope lifetime, capability and aggregate GPU budget checks, and integration across all scenario capture paths; owner: maintainers
